name: Shisamu & Kisara
source:
[The First Officer's Twins]
Their names are Shisamu and Kisara. Born in the North Sea, these twin sisters serve together as first officers.

They work as a pair because they suffer from a peculiar affliction: if they aren’t in constant physical contact with one another, they begin to lose their sanity—making it impossible for them to ever be apart. 

They are most at ease when pressed back-to-back; in this position, they possess an uncanny sense of direction and spatial awareness, as if they were equipped with a high-performance GPS system. While they are among the more "sensible" members of the crew, they have no qualms about engaging in illicit activities like smuggling, petty theft, or fraud.

If they are forced to separate, they tether themselves together with a lifeline—but this can only sustain them for about three hours. They harbor a vague, lingering desire to find partners of their own and escape this ship for good.
